description: Election Commission - Mr. K. G. Waudasiri of the Rayanganaya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member
categorisation: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Rajanganaya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local government elections, specifically addressing the vacation of office by an elected member, which is covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
